now.body: Alongside my studies at ÉTS, I build my skills on my own and across disciplines. I explore different areas of software engineering, but also entrepreneurship, product strategy, leadership, and the responsibilities that come with CEO and CTO roles. To keep progressing, I rely on video courses, reading and hands-on exercises — notably on YouTube, LeetCode and DeepLearning.AI. In parallel, I build several projects I truly care about as a founder and co-founder, while taking on various client mandates. These experiences strengthen my technical and human versatility, and my ability to turn needs into concrete solutions. I stay open and available for an internship, a job or new collaborations in Greater Montréal, hybrid or remote.

about.title: About
about.heading: I build web products people actually use.
paragraphs: Full-stack developer based in Repentigny, Greater Montréal. Bilingual EN/FR, currently studying B.Eng. in Software Engineering at ÉTS, I have been shipping web products since 2022 — solo, in teams, and as a co-founder.

My approach: ship to production, not just demos. The Mad Space runs today with ~15,000 LOC, 30+ API endpoints, multi-currency Stripe payments (4 currencies), 7+ B2B integrations and 4 business workflows that cut order processing by 10–15 minutes.

Before product development, I resolved 2,000+ tickets at Vidéotron with 94% customer satisfaction (9.6/10) and automated ~50% of tasks via Power Automate. I learned to listen before coding, and to diagnose before proposing.
about.caption: Ralph Christian Gabriel · Repentigny, QC

github.heading: GitHub activity.
github.sub: Consistent commits, real projects, open source contributions.
highlights: Currently building a SaaS coaching platform (Next.js 16, React 19, TypeScript, Supabase) and maintaining a full-stack e-commerce platform with 15,000+ LOC.
Open to collaborating on full-stack web apps, open-source developer tools, and products that integrate AI.
Ask me about Next.js, React, TypeScript, REST API design, e-commerce integrations (Stripe, Gelato), or CI/CD pipelines.

about.beyondCodeSub: A few things that shape how I think and work.

marathon.title: Half-Marathon Finisher
marathon.desc: I ran 21.1 km to support Laval firefighters. Months of training taught me what I also find in software development every day: consistency, trusting the process, and finishing what you start.

chess.title: Chess Player
chess.desc: Chess forces me to anticipate, read patterns, and think several moves ahead. That's exactly what I do when designing the architecture of a system.

skiing.title: Skier
skiing.desc: Skiing is my reset. It forces me to read the terrain, react quickly, and fully commit to every turn.

personality.title: How I work
personality.desc: I think in systems: I go deep before going wide, I plan before I code, and I document so what I ship keeps working without me. Curious and methodical, I'm most comfortable once I understand the "why" before the "how".
points: Diagnose before proposing — a habit from IT support.
Plan, then move in small, verifiable steps.
Document and test so the code lasts.
Keep learning, and share what I figure out.

items.desc: Co-founding a coach ↔ athlete sports-coaching mobile app with Alexandre Boisvert. Tech-Lead planning: 169+ structured issues across 13 sprints, competitive audit of 8+ apps, Loi 25 · PIPEDA · GDPR-ready compliance. Stack: Expo/React Native, TypeScript, NativeWind, Supabase. Live Next.js landing page (cadence-web-fawn.vercel.app), source on GitHub.

High-fidelity design and prototyping of web and mobile products, from client brief to implementation: Wise & Wealthy (AI financial coach), Kim Dubois Photographe (portfolio site, first paying client), Vibe Montréal (smart local discovery), DPM Elevate (life-management app — calendar, tasks, habits) and BOA (private-chef & table-service booking site). Design systems, bilingual FR/EN, light/dark, targeting Next.js + TypeScript.

Configuration and integration of TMS solutions via database setup. Google Maps integration (geocoding). Structured Test → Dev → Production deployment with GitLab CI/CD Pipelines. Stack: Spring Boot, Angular.

Designed and shipped a print-on-demand e-commerce marketplace (~15,000 LOC, 30+ API endpoints). 10+ Prisma/PostgreSQL models, custom session-based auth, Google OAuth 2.0, i18n (2 languages), multi-currency (4). 7+ B2B integrations (Stripe, Gelato, Google Merchant Center, GA4, Google Ads). GDPR/Loi 25 compliance. Vercel/Supabase deployment, Deno Edge Functions.
2,000+ tickets handled (AHT 11:18, 94% sat. · 9.6/10). Automated ~50% of tasks via Power Automate (HR/IT/Finance). Documented procedures and runbooks to stabilize deployments.

services.heading: What I can bring you.
services.intro: Whether you have a site to launch, an idea to validate or a team to strengthen, here's concretely what I can do. Each example points to a real project: no promises of results, only what I've already shipped.

items.title: Web sites and applications
items.problem: A site that doesn't convert, a patched-together internal tool, or no web presence at all.
items.deliver: A fast, accessible bilingual web app, from design through to launch. Usually on Next.js, TypeScript and PostgreSQL.
items.example: The Mad Space, an e-commerce marketplace in production.

items.title: Prototypes and web/mobile MVPs
items.problem: An idea that's hard to show to clients, partners or investors.
items.deliver: An interactive, clickable prototype that makes the idea testable, then a codebase ready for what's next.
items.example: Wise & Wealthy, a concept turned into a full, testable mockup.

items.title: Integrations and automation
items.audience: Teams losing time on manual tasks
items.problem: Data retyped by hand, payments or emails to wire up, slow processes.
items.deliver: Integrations (payments, fulfillment, third-party APIs) and automation that remove the manual steps.
items.example: The Mad Space, 7+ B2B integrations and automated fulfillment.

items.title: Strengthening a team
items.problem: You're looking for a versatile, self-driven profile who can deliver from design through to production.
items.deliver: A full-stack developer who designs, codes, tests and ships, and documents so the team can keep up.
items.example: DPM Elevate, a complete app designed and delivered solo.

testimonials.quote: Ralph Christian Gabriel is an expert in his field! He helped me on numerous occasions with my computer technical issues. testimonials.quote: When I wanted to bring the idea of Cadence to life, Ralph was the first person I thought of to join me on this adventure. A former classmate, Ralph has always shown exceptional rigor. He quickly demonstrated the same rigor and expertise as a business partner. He approaches every problem with genuine deep thinking — he considers the architecture, anticipates issues, and delivers clean, maintainable work. What particularly impressed me is his ability to learn fast and adapt to the real constraints of a project under construction. He took on complex technical challenges autonomously while remaining a reliable thinking partner. I would recommend Ralph at any time without the slightest hesitation.
